title: Store energy in a coil
hook: Change current magnitude and predict stored magnetic energy.
misconception: stored magnetic energy doubles when current magnitude doubles, regardless of the stated relationship.
objective: Apply U = LI²/2 to compare stored magnetic energy when current magnitude changes, under the stated assumptions.

claims.text: With an ideal inductor with fixed inductance, U = LI²/2. When current magnitude doubles, stored magnetic energy becomes 4 times its original value.
claims.source: Idealized model U = LI²/2; scaling exponent 2. Physics and assumptions await independent review.

recall.question: Consider an ideal inductor with fixed inductance, with a nonzero initial result. If current magnitude triples from a positive value, what is the multiplier on stored magnetic energy?
recall.why: Apply U = LI²/2 under the same assumptions: the multiplier is 9.
